channel.title: Texas Legislature - Today's Filed Bills in the House
channel.description: Bills filed on 11/19/2026. An appearance of a bill on this list is a result of it being filed by a representative or senator.

item.title: HB 1246 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Howard
item.description: Relating to the authority to lease real property or an improvement on the Austin State Hospital campus for less than market rate and the lease of certain state property by the Health and Human Services Commission to Travis County.

item.title: HB 1247 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Reynolds
item.description: Relating to the expansion of eligibility for Medicaid to certain individuals under the federal Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act.

item.title: HB 1248 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Morales, Christina
item.description: Relating to designating July 7 as Lorenzo Salgado Araujo Day.

item.title: HB 1249 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Gervin-Hawkins
item.description: Relating to the imposition of consecutive sentences for more than one criminal offense of injury to a child, elderly individual, or disabled individual arising out of the same criminal episode.

item.title: HB 1250 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Bucy
item.description: Relating to a collision data reporting requirement for automated motor vehicle authorization holders.

item.title: HCR 21 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Darby
item.description: Redesignating Big Spring as the official Lighted Poinsettia Capital of Texas for a 10-year period ending in 2037.

item.title: HR 29 Introduced
item.dc:creator: Louderback
item.description: Recognizing January 27, 2027, as Texas Police Chiefs Day at the State Capitol.
